shared_elements: repeated small motifs incised into a surface
justification: A shows dense horizontal registers of small pictographic signs (birds, arms, loaves, reeds) running as continuous text lines, while B is a monolithic anthropomorphic figure with a head, shoulders and torso bearing a few large isolated motifs including a prominent ring/disc on the back and crescent-like bands. The only real correspondence is that both surfaces carry shallow relief carving with rounded, oval sign-like elements; the organisation (script-like rows versus scattered emblems on a sculpted body) and the presence of a human form in B are wholly different.
